title: HPAP Processing Protocol
author: Michael Betts
materials: For long term storage, store in liquid nitrogen

steps.title: Blood PBMC Isolation & Cryopreservation
steps.instruction: Process peripheral blood to isolate PBMCs and cryopreserve them.

substeps.instruction: Spin down blood vials at 2000 rpm for 15 min at room temperature.
Aliquot plasma into cryovials, freeze at –80 °C, and discard the remaining plasma.
Measure the volume of the spun‑down blood and transfer it to a new conical tube.
Wash the vials with R10 media (RPMI + 10 % FBS + 2 mM L‑Glutamine + 100 U/mL Penicillin + 100 µg/mL Streptomycin) using a 1:1 ratio of blood to R10, then transfer the mixture to the conical tube.
In a SepMate™‑50 conical, add 15 mL Ficoll below the physical barrier.
Slowly layer the blood on top of the Ficoll without mixing.
Centrifuge at 1200 g for 10 min at room temperature.
Carefully pour the supernatant containing PBMCs into a fresh conical tube.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 7 min.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in approximately 2 mL ACK lysis buffer.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 min, then quench with 18 mL R10 media.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 7 min.
Resuspend the pellet in 10 mL R10 media.
Count the cells.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 7 min.
Discard supernatant and resuspend the pellet in FBS + 10 % DMSO at 5–10 × 10⁶ cells/mL.
Aliquot 1 mL per cryovial and freeze at –80 °C in a Mr. Frosty container for 24–48 h.
Transfer vials to liquid nitrogen for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Lymph Node Cell Isolation & Cryopreservation
steps.instruction: Isolate cells from lymph node tissue and cryopreserve them.

substeps.instruction: Prepare media by adding 50 µL DNase to 50 mL R10 media for each tissue type.
Weigh the lymph node tissue in a culture dish and record its mass.
Add 10 mL of the prepared media to the dish.
Place the tissue in the dish and gently trim away fat.
Rinse the tissue with an additional 10 mL of the prepared media.
For histology: cut a ~1–2 cm piece, place it in 50 mL PBS + 4 % PFA, label with date/time, store ~24 h at room temperature, then transfer to 50 mL conical containing 80 % ethanol and store at 4 °C.
Transfer remaining tissue pieces to a 70 µm cell strainer and grind with the plunger of a 5 mL syringe.
Strain the released cells and media through the strainer into a fresh 50 mL conical.
Rinse the plate several times with remaining media, straining each rinse through the same strainer into the conical.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 7 min.
Discard supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 10 mL R10 media.
Count the cells.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 7 min.
Discard supernatant and resuspend the pellet in FBS + 10 % DMSO at 5–10 × 10⁶ cells/mL.
Aliquot 1 mL per cryovial and freeze at –80 °C in a Mr. Frosty container for 24–48 h.
Transfer vials to liquid nitrogen for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Spleen Cell Isolation & Cryopreservation
steps.instruction: Dissociate spleen tissue, isolate cells, and cryopreserve them.

substeps.instruction: Prepare media by adding 50 µL DNase, 50 µL Collagenase, and 50 mL R10 media.
Weigh the spleen tissue in a culture dish and record its mass.
Cut the tissue into ~2 cm pieces.
Dissociate the pieces using a gentleMACS instrument in the prepared media.
Incubate the suspension for 15 min at 37 °C on a rotator.
Repeat the gentleMACS dissociation.
Pass the suspension through a 100 µm filter.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 10 min.
Discard supernatant and add approximately 10 mL ACK lysis buffer to the pellet.
Incubate for 5 min, then quench with 40 mL R10 media.
Pass the suspension through a 70 µm filter.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 10 min at room temperature.
Add 10 mL Ficoll to a clean 50 mL conical tube.
Resuspend the cells and carefully layer them on top of the Ficoll.
Centrifuge at 2200 rpm for 20 min with the brake off.
Resuspend the cell layer in 10 mL R10 media.
Dilute 10 µL of this suspension in 990 µL PBS.
Count cells and multiply the count by 1000 to obtain the total cell number.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 10 min.
Discard supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 20–30 mL FBS + 10 % DMSO.
Aliquot the suspension into 20–30 vials (≈1 mL each) and freeze at –80 °C in a Mr. Frosty container for 24–48 h.
Transfer vials to liquid nitrogen for long‑term storage.
